name: Hashabiah
overview: The name Hashabiah appears multiple times in Scripture, primarily identifying several Levites who served in various capacities related to temple worship and leadership. These include chief Levites such as the son of Amaziah and the son of Jeduthun, as well as a Merarite Levite mentioned alongside others in Ezra 8:19. Hashabiah is also noted as a ruler in Nehemiah 3:17 and as a chief priest responsible for temple valuables, reflecting a trusted role in the sacred service. The genealogical references in Nehemiah 11 highlight the continuity of Levite service through descendants like the sons of Bunni and Mattaniah, underscoring the importance of faithful stewardship in the worship of God.
